records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/README.md#what-it-does-today
records.summary: Rikuy is a static browser brief over Quipu: a Today brief, Ask cards, passkey-signed decisions, settlement into Seeds, a graph explorer and a job-cost report. It is not a separate knowledge store. The demo and the job-cost report work from a clean checkout; live reads and signing are built and ship switched off.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/rikuy/web%2Flegacy%2Fconfig.mjs
records.summary: The immutable reader configuration owns graph/source bindings, enabled state, transport, bounded response limits and registration. No URL or browser-storage switch supplies activation authority.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/README.md#install
records.summary: The source installer builds the current public main branch and copies only the static output into a revision-named folder. It starts no server and configures no credentials or live connection; no prebuilt, checksummed package is published yet.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Fhow-it-works.md
records.summary: Every part that talks to a server ships switched off. A deployment turns a part on only after its queries are registered, their read cost is accepted and its scope is fixed in configuration. Credentials, private keys, operator snapshots and demo fixtures never ship in a build. Missing evidence is shown as UNKNOWN, never zero.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/README.md
records.summary: Start with what works today and the synthetic demo; a working demo does not prove admitted live reads or signing enrollment.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Freference.md
records.summary: Read the configuration reference before supplying a graph, exact query registration, accepted read cost or other deployment-owned evidence.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/rikuy/README.md#before-you-start
records.summary: Confirm the runtime, browser and admitted-read requirements; keep credentials on the server and every reader, signing and enrollment switched off until each is admitted.
